title: Strict structured-output validator
description: Validates a small documented JSON Schema-inspired subset: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum, string length, number bounds, and array length. Unsupported schema keywords fail explicitly. JSON parsing rejects NaN/Infinity and duplicate keys. Booleans are not accepted as numbers. This is not a complete JSON Schema implementation and cannot verify the factual truth of valid-shaped outputs.
